caption:
Back from a break and flat by Wednesday? The drains might still be plugged in.

Even in studies of healthy workers, the lift from a holiday fades in the weeks after going back. Recovery from burnout is often about fewer drains, not only more charge. Which one could you turn down, even a little?

Send this to someone who has just gone back to work.
